title: Storytelling Session!
shortDescription: We are delighted to announce the launch of the IGEN Library Kids Book Club—a fun and engaging space where children can develop a love for reading, creativity, and learning.
description:
Ya Ali Madad,

Dear Parents,

We are delighted to announce the launch of the IGEN Library Kids Book Club—a fun and engaging space where children can develop a love for reading, creativity, and learning.

🎉 Our first activity is a Storytelling Session!
📖 Activity: Storytelling
📅 Date: This Saturday
🕠 Time: 5:30 PM – 6:30 PM
💰 Participation Fee: Rs. 100 per child

Through exciting stories and interactive activities, children will build their imagination, listening skills, confidence, and love for books.
We invite all parents to encourage their children to join us for this wonderful beginning.

📍 Venue: IGEN Library (Inaara Garden Education Network)Limited seats are available. Kindly register your child in advance.

Let's inspire young minds to Read, Learn, and Grow together! 📚✨
